name: Opening Range Breakout
thesis: Momentum out of the first 15-min range tends to continue. Usually a lower-WR breakout play - must prove it fits high-WR / low-RR after costs.
rules: Range = high/low of params.range_window (09:30-09:45 or 09:15-09:30 ET). Buy stop 1 tick above the high / sell stop 1 tick below the low; first break is the only trade of the day, entries 09:30-11:00 (from range end), flat 11:30. Stop: other side of the range (1 tick past) or range middle. Target = 0.5 R (x stop distance). ATR modes: off, range-filter (skip if range > 0.35 x ATR14), atr-stop (stop = 0.1 x ATR14 from fill). Bar breaking both sides = skip. Code: tools/backtest/setups/orb.py.

stop.note: params.stop_at: other side of range / range middle; atr-stop mode: atr_stop x ATR
